subject.title: Slack: Include file attachment metadata in inbound message delivery to agents

question: Should OpenClaw add a shared agent-facing inbound attachment metadata contract for Slack and sibling channels, or keep attachment details limited to placeholders plus Media* fields?
rationale: The missing data is clear in source, but field shape, privacy boundaries, and cross-channel semantics change the agent-facing channel/plugin contract and should be chosen by maintainers.

options.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
options.body: Introduce a cross-channel structured attachment field covering provider ids, filenames, MIME types, sizes, local paths, and download status while preserving legacy fields.

options.title: Keep Current Contract
options.body: Document that Slack fileId is available through placeholders and defer structured metadata until more channels require it.

options.title: Prototype Slack Only
options.body: Add a Slack-only metadata field first, accepting possible migration risk if the shared contract differs later.

recommendation.title: Add Shared Attachment Metadata
recommendation.body: Introduce a cross-channel structured attachment field covering provider ids, filenames, MIME types, sizes, local paths, and download status while preserving legacy fields.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue discussion already routed the API/product question to this person and history ties them to Slack media behavior.
